payload.title: FlashAttention-4 Release: Algorithm Pipeline Redesign
payload.summary: Overview of FlashAttention-4's official release, covering the fundamental pipeline redesign that achieves near-matmul-speed attention on Blackwell GPUs through co-design with asymmetrically scaled hardware.

sections.heading: 1. Overview
sections.gist: FlashAttention-4 is officially released after a year of development.

sections.heading: 2. Hardware Trend: Asymmetric Scaling
sections.gist: FA3 targeted Hopper (H100); the industry has rapidly shifted to Blackwell (B200/GB200).

sections.heading: 3. FA4 Co-Design
sections.gist: Core objective: maximize overlap between matrix multiplication and other bottleneck resources, achieving 1605 TFLOPS/s (71% utilization), 1.3× faster than cuDNN 9.13, 2.7× faster than Triton.

sections.heading: 4. Blackwell Hardware Features
sections.gist: **Tensor Memory (TMEM):** B200's 148 SMs each have 256 KB TMEM, directly connected to Tensor Core, used for warp-synchronous intermediate result storage.

sections.heading: 5. Programming Language: CuTe-DSL
sections.gist: FA4 is implemented entirely in CuTe-DSL (CUTLASS's Python kernel DSL): write kernels in Python → DSL lowers to PTX → CUDA toolchain compiles to GPU machine code.

sections.heading: 6. Performance Benchmarks
sections.gist: - **Forward:** 1.1–1.3× faster than cuDNN 9.13, 2.1–2.7× faster than Triton - **Backward:** Consistently outperforms other baselines on long sequences
